properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Web-Facing Service Process Writes to RCE/Persistence Paths (Path-Traversal File-Write)
properties.description:
Detects a public-facing server process (Python web/AI app, Java/Tomcat, Node, nginx/httpd, php-fpm) creating or modifying a file OUTSIDE its expected working directory and INSIDE an RCE- or persistence-enabling location — cron drop-ins, ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, shell rc files, Python site-/dist-packages, or a web-root script (.jsp/.php/.aspx). This fortnight a cluster of arbitrary-file-write / path-traversal flaws in AI and comms tooling drove it: Crawl4AI's /screenshot,/pdf output_path traversal and crawler-download traversal (GHSA-365w-hqf6-vxfg, GHSA-2jq4-q6vv-4cp3), Langflow's unauthenticated upload and BaseFileComponent file primitives (CVE-2026-55450, CVE-2026-55447), PraisonAI's unvalidated multiedit tool (GHSA-29w3-p9w9-wc47), gemini-mcp-tool @file/cmd injection (CVE-2026-0755), and the actively-exploited Cisco Unified CM file-write-to-root chain (CVE-2026-20230) that drops a JSP webshell. It spans the exploit→install/persistence kill-chain stages: the public app is abused for write primitive, then the bytes land where they grant code execution or footholds. It FIRES when a long-lived service identity writes to these high-value paths; it does NOT fire on package managers (apt/pip/dpkg), legitimate deploy/CI agents, or interactive admin shells, which are filtered out. Reference IOCs (`<c2_domain_list>`, `<sha256_list>`) are substitution slots only — the detection keys on the write-target + writing-process behaviour, not on rotating hashes.

Rationale: All seven articles share one observable regardless of the specific CVE: an internet-facing service is coerced into writing attacker-controlled bytes to a path that yields code execution or a foothold (cron, ssh keys, shell rc, site-packages, web-root script). Keying on writing-process identity + write-target rather than per-app IOCs catches the joint path-traversal/arbitrary-file-write tradecraft as new affected products land.
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("python","python3","java","node","httpd","nginx","tomcat","uwsgi","gunicorn","php-fpm","w3wp.exe")
| where FolderPath has_any ("/etc/cron","/var/spool/cron","/.ssh/",".bashrc",".bash_profile",".profile",".zshrc","/site-packages/","/dist-packages/","/webapps/","\\wwwroot\\","/axis2-web/")
   or FileName endswith "authorized_keys"
   or FileName has_any (".jsp",".jspx",".php",".aspx")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("apt","dpkg","pip install","yum","dnf"))
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Writes=count(), SampleTarget=any(FolderPath)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ActionType
| order by LastSeen desc
